# Profession Guides

<!-- This page is generated by tools/professions/build.py. -->

A guide for each of the **12 professions**. Each guide gives a path from skill 1 to 300, the materials for the path, the recipes to get, and the full recipe list.

??? info "How the profession guides work · current as of 10 November 2026"
    - **Recipe data:** from the game client, build 1.60.1.70862, as read by [wowforevertalents.com](https://wowforevertalents.com/professions/).
    - **Paths and picks:** Codex recommendations. A script checks each path against the recipe data.
    - **Not in the client:** trainer skill requirements, prices and drop locations. The guides mark Classic-era values and estimates.
    - For the rules of professions and the best professions for each class, see [Professions](../characters/professions.md).

## Crafting professions

<div class="grid cards fc-multi" markdown>

-   :material-flask:{ .lg .middle } **[Alchemy](alchemy.md)**

    ---

    Potions, elixirs, flasks and transmutations from herbs. Each class and each raid uses them.

    - **Pairs with:** Herbalism gives the herbs. Fishing gives the fish for the oils.
    - **Recipes:** 179

-   :material-anvil:{ .lg .middle } **[Blacksmithing](blacksmithing.md)**

    ---

    Mail and plate armor, weapons, weapon stones, skeleton keys and rods for Enchanters.

    - **Pairs with:** Mining. It supplies the bars and the stones for almost all recipes.
    - **Recipes:** 441

-   :material-auto-fix:{ .lg .middle } **[Enchanting](enchanting.md)**

    ---

    Enchants for each gear slot, wands, staves, relics and weapon oils. Disenchant changes unwanted gear into materials.

    - **Pairs with:** Tailoring makes cheap items to disenchant. Blacksmithing makes the inert rods.
    - **Recipes:** 225

-   :material-cog:{ .lg .middle } **[Engineering](engineering.md)**

    ---

    Explosives, guns, scopes, ammunition, goggles and devices from bars, stone and cloth. Makes the Reagent Bot and the Repair Bot for a camp.

    - **Pairs with:** Mining, for the bars and the stone.
    - **Recipes:** 247

-   :material-bag-personal:{ .lg .middle } **[Leatherworking](leatherworking.md)**

    ---

    Leather armor, mail armor, armor kits, quivers and a reagent bag. The Camp Tent gives rested XP.

    - **Pairs with:** Skinning. It supplies the leather and the hides.
    - **Recipes:** 512

-   :material-needle:{ .lg .middle } **[Tailoring](tailoring.md)**

    ---

    Bags, reagent bags and cloth armor from cloth. The best crafting profession for Mages, Priests and Warlocks.

    - **Pairs with:** Enchanting, which disenchants the armor that you make. First Aid uses the same cloth.
    - **Recipes:** 417

</div>

## Gathering professions

<div class="grid cards fc-multi" markdown>

-   :material-leaf:{ .lg .middle } **[Herbalism](herbalism.md)**

    ---

    Herbs for Alchemy and for First Aid potions. Camp features that start with the Incense Candle.

    - **Pairs with:** Alchemy for your own potions. Skinning for more materials, because it needs no tracking. First Aid and Cooking also use herbs.
    - **Recipes:** 3

-   :material-pickaxe:{ .lg .middle } **[Mining](mining.md)**

    ---

    Ore, stone and bars for Blacksmithing and Engineering. The Lodestone camp feature gives melee attack power.

    - **Pairs with:** Blacksmithing or Engineering. Take a second gathering profession if you want to sell materials.
    - **Recipes:** 18

-   :material-knife:{ .lg .middle } **[Skinning](skinning.md)**

    ---

    Leather and hides from dead beasts. Tanning adds 3 camp features.

    - **Pairs with:** Leatherworking uses the leather. Mining or Herbalism adds a second gathering profession.
    - **Recipes:** 3

</div>

## Secondary skills

<div class="grid cards fc-multi" markdown>

-   :material-pot-steam:{ .lg .middle } **[Cooking](cooking.md)**

    ---

    Stat food, campfires for the camping system, and new teas and smoothies. Useful for each class.

    - **Pairs with:** Fishing gives the fish for more than 20 recipes. Herbalism gives the herbs for the teas.
    - **Recipes:** 125

-   :material-medical-bag:{ .lg .middle } **[First Aid](first-aid.md)**

    ---

    Bandages, healing potions and curatives from cloth and herbs. Useful for each class.

    - **Pairs with:** All professions. Tailoring uses the same cloth. Herbalism gives the herbs for the healing potions.
    - **Recipes:** 32

-   :material-fish:{ .lg .middle } **[Fishing](fishing.md)**

    ---

    Fish for Cooking and Alchemy, and 3 camp features. The Fish Bowl gives +8% stats at a camp.

    - **Pairs with:** Cooking, which uses the fish. Alchemy, which makes oils from Oily Blackmouth, Firefin Snapper and Stonescale Eel.
    - **Recipes:** 3

</div>
